I saw the doctor, who examined me and removed earwax (a very large piece came out – see the picture! 😆).
My ear feels clear now, I can hear clearly, and it's no longer muffled or wet. It's like having a brand new ear, after experiencing intermittent muffled and blocked hearing for so long. 👏👏
He also checked my eardrum and confirmed it was normal, and there were no other inflammations.
The doctor provided excellent service, spoke kindly and politely, and gave great advice and consultation.
**The doctor explained that the earwax, which was already abundant, swells and becomes wet when exposed to water, obstructing hearing.
The total cost was 400 baht. 😍🥰
Dr. Apichai has earned my highest praise!

text:
We chose this clinic because of its very high rating – 4.9 stars. Even though the prices are higher than many other places, we decided to go there, expecting high-quality diagnostics and a professional approach.

Unfortunately, my experience was completely different. I was misdiagnosed and prescribed treatment that didn't help. As a result, I wasted time, money, and several days of discomfort.

Dear doctor, please pay more attention to examining patients before making a diagnosis and prescribing treatment. People come to you for qualified help and trust your judgment.

When a clinic charges a fairly high fee for a visit, you expect a corresponding level of professionalism and diagnostic accuracy. Unfortunately, this did not happen in my case.

After this visit, I was left feeling disappointed and lost trust. I hope my review will help the clinic improve its quality of work and avoid similar situations with other patients.

restaurant_name: คลินิกหู คอ จมูก แพทย์อภิชัย (พัทยา)
text:
I am very disappointed with the quality of diagnostics at this clinic. 👎👎👎👎

I came in with an earache. After examining me, the doctor diagnosed a bacterial infection and prescribed treatment. We paid about 1,100 baht for the appointment and medication.

I took antibiotics and other prescribed medications for five days, experiencing discomfort and hoping for improvement. However, not only was the problem not properly addressed, but it was later discovered that the cause was a fungal infection, not a bacterial one.

I have a question: how could they not distinguish between a fungal infection and a bacterial one? Due to the misdiagnosis, I wasted time, money, and spent several days on unnecessary antibiotics.

My husband ultimately purchased another medication from the pharmacy, and his condition began to improve.

A very unpleasant experience. I expected a more professional approach and an accurate diagnosis. I was extremely dissatisfied and disappointed. I cannot recommend this clinic.
